summary: True-peak lookahead limiter: input gain drives the signal into a ceiling in dBTP, detected 4× oversampled as BS.1770 measures it, so the output's true peak stays under the ceiling. Program-dependent (auto) or set release, stereo link. Use it last on the master to reach a loudness target without overs, or to catch peaks on a bus.

parameters.name: Input gain
parameters.description: Gain into the limiter in 0.1 dB steps: raises loudness by pushing the signal into the ceiling

parameters.name: Ceiling
parameters.description: The output's true-peak limit (dBTP), 0.1 dB steps

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Time for 63 % of a reduction to recover; with Auto release, the time sustained limiting recovers in (short peaks recover faster)

parameters.name: Auto release
parameters.description: Program-dependent release: short peaks recover fast, sustained limiting slowly (less distortion on dense material)

parameters.name: Lookahead
parameters.description: The gain starts falling this long before a peak arrives (longer: smoother, less distortion; adds latency)

parameters.name: Stereo link
parameters.description: 100 %: both channels get the same gain (the image stays put); 0 %: each channel on its own
